claims.statement: Border, background, radius and the focus ring belong to the group, so a control placed beside the input sits inside the same outline instead of next to it.
Focusing any part of the group lights one ring on the group, which is the visible evidence that the parts are one control.
An action declares where it sits on a field that grows, so a composer keeps its expand affordance at the top and its send affordance at the bottom.
An adornment supplies its own gutter and collapses the control's padding on that side, so callers never hand-tune padding to clear a prefix.
A disabled group blocks pointer input and marks itself, and disables the segments it owns, but never reports disabled state on controls it does not own.

A control inside the group surrenders its own chrome in every interaction state, not just at rest, so a hover rule the control ships cannot repaint half the field a different colour from the other half.
Pill means as round as one row allows: a true stadium at the resting height, and a well-rounded rectangle once the field grows, rather than a lozenge.
Once the host reports the field has grown, the actions leave their fixed lane and take a row beneath the text, which returns the full width to the control that ran out of it.

component.purpose: One field shell for an input and the controls attached to it, so a text box and its buttons read and behave as a single control.
